title: Integrated modeling for the transition pathway of China's power system
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3699-3717
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00355E, Paper
Ziheng Zhu, Da Zhang, Xiaoye Zhang, Xiliang Zhang
A temporally and spatially resolved model charts feasible transition pathways of China's power system to negative emissions by 2060 through renewables expansion and carbon capture.
